PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSeparation.finite_absolute_system_separator : ∀ (n : ℕ) [inst : NeZero n] (L : Type u_1)
  [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : NumberField L] [inst_3 : IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ L] {Λ : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3}
  {E : Type u_4} [inst_4 : Field E] [inst_5 : Fintype I] [inst_6 : DecidableEq I] {K : Λ → Type u_5}
  [inst_7 : (l : Λ) → Field (K l)] [∀ (l : Λ), CharZero (K l)] [inst_9 : (l : Λ) → TopologicalSpace (K l)]
  [∀ (l : Λ), IsTopologicalRing (K l)] [∀ (l : Λ), T2Space (K l)] {W : Λ → I → Type u_6}
  [inst_12 : (l : Λ) → (i : I) → AddCommGroup (W l i)] [inst_13 : (l : Λ) → (i : I) → _root_.Module (K l) (W l i)]
  [∀ (l : Λ) (i : I), FiniteDimensional (K l) (W l i)] (ρ : (l : Λ) → (i : I) → Representation (K l) Gal(L/ℚ) (W l i))
  [∀ (l : Λ) (i : I),
      Representation.IsIrreducible (MonoidHom.comp (ρ l i) (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L))]
  (emb : (l : Λ) → E →+* K l) (t : I → PaperX.CyclotomicPrimeCoverage.PermittedPrime n ∅ → E)
  (good : Λ → PaperX.CyclotomicPrimeCoverage.PermittedPrime n ∅ → Prop),
  (∀ (l : Λ), {p | ¬good l p}.Finite) →
    (∀ (l : Λ) (i : I) (p : PaperX.CyclotomicPrimeCoverage.PermittedPrime n ∅),
        good l p →
          Representation.character (MonoidHom.comp (ρ l i) (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L))
              (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.liftSample n L p) =
            (emb l) (t i p)) →
      (∀ (i j : I),
          PaperX.CompatibleSystemRigidity.MemberwiseEquiv
              (fun l i => MonoidHom.comp (ρ l i) (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L)) i j →
            i = j) →
        ∀ (l₀ : Λ) (forbidden : Finset ℕ),
          ∃ v,
            (Function.Injective fun i => ↑(v i)) ∧
              (∀ (i : I), good l₀ (v i)) ∧
                (∀ (i : I), ↑(v i) ∉ forbidden) ∧
                  (PaperX.FiniteSeparation.sampleMatrix t v).det ≠ 0 ∧
                    (∀ (l : Λ), ((emb l).mapMatrix (PaperX.FiniteSeparation.sampleMatrix t v)).det ≠ 0) ∧
                      ∀ (l : Λ) (j i : I) (γ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ),
                        (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L) γ =
                            PaperX.CyclotomicPrimeCoverage.primeSample n L ∅ (v j) →
                          good l (v j) →
                            (emb l).mapMatrix (PaperX.FiniteSeparation.sampleMatrix t v) j i =
                              Representation.character
                                (MonoidHom.comp (ρ l i) (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L)) γ
PaperX.CyclotomicInertiaBridge.restriction_eq_one_of_coprime_inertia : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (L : Type u_1)
  [inst : Field L] [inst_1 : NumberField L] [inst_2 : IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ L]
  (A : ValuationSubring (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A) p],
  p.Coprime n →
    ∀ σ ∈ ValuationSubring.inertiaSubgroup ℚ A,
      (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L)
          (have this := ↑σ;
          this) =
        1
PaperX.CyclotomicInertiaBridge.pullback_on_arithmeticFrobenius : ∀ (n : ℕ) [inst : NeZero n] (L : Type u_1)
  [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : NumberField L] [inst_3 : IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ L] {K : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3}
  [inst_4 : Field K] [inst_5 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_6 : _root_.Module K V] (ρ : Representation K Gal(L/ℚ) V)
  (A : ValuationSubring (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A) p]
  (hp : p.Coprime n) (σ : ↥(ValuationSubring.decompositionSubgroup ℚ A)),
  (∀ (z : ↥A), (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) (σ • z) = (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) z ^ p) →
    (MonoidHom.comp ρ (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L))
        (have this := ↑σ;
        this) =
      ρ (PaperX.CyclotomicPrimeCoverage.primePowerAutomorphism n L p hp)
